profile.headline: Software developer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Currently Back-end software developer for oracle IaaS solution Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Bachelor in computer science, international business  and Master student in cyber security.

positions.title: Back-end cloud developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, troubleshoot and debug software programs for databases, applications, tools, networks etc.

Assist in defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, debugging or designing of software applications or operating systems. Provide technical leadership to other software developers. Specify, design and implement modest changes to existing software architecture to meet changing needs.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Directed the development of create operations for items in the product information management platform while also doing
significant upgrades to the merge operation based on a known issue to the platform.
Wrote documentation of several process and program guides regarding the workflow of a newcomer and the development
and maintenance of the ADF platform, making an integrated development manual for the most common PIM software.
Solved several WLS issues where the production couldn’t see the proper output of the log stack trace

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Increased user satisfaction by optimizing data retrieval from the server, going from several minutes to seconds.
Developed python scripting for web scraping, which allowed developers to easily tell which sites are not available. Also,
created easy-to-follow reports based on this information.
Developed SQL-stored procedures using scrum methodology implementation.

certifications.name: React: Creating and Hosting a Full-Stack Site
